title: Map node #115 root digest selector production

scope.question: What selected reads and branches produce the root digest selector byte, without naming CPU feature semantics not established by evidence?
include: The selector fallback decision path and repeated cell reads
exclude: All writers and synchronization for the selector cell

remaining_gap: The fallback edge and repeated cell reads are recorded. Runtime CPU feature values and the behavior of the cell under concurrent access remain unresolved.
downstream_consumer: A small independently checked checkpoint-to-replay-to-root-validation fixture shared by this pilot.
acceptance_requirements: Verify the target digest, selector call site, selected branch bytes, FDE bounds, and relocation or data references.
Preserve repeated reads and branches rather than assuming a stable runtime cell.
Do not infer runtime CPU values or complete the RE-009 gate from a partial selector packet.
required_capabilities: Static x86-64 control-flow and relocation analysis

evidence_review.decision: Merged in 791e0ffceea75d14b15d82e6bc19294a6ea2e659. The reproduced selector packet binds the selected fallback to 0x5cadd50 and the cell to 0x6500098. Runtime values remain unknown.
